explanation_target.declared_class: required integer class index; never silently replaced

request_fields.prediction_scope: SLICE (current LOC handlers); BAG requires a separately bound bag predictor and perturbation protocol
request_fields.class_labels: ordered model class names; source disease semantics require explicit provenance
request_fields.source_label: null if unknown; otherwise {class_id, label, scope, provenance_sha256}; never inferred from prediction or copied from CASE/BAG to SLICE
request_fields.model_binding: exact model, preprocessing, adapter SHA-256 and task version; different model is a different experiment
request_fields.loss_definition: exact optimization and descriptive metric definitions below

result_fields.explanation_target: request fields plus resolved_class; declared_class must equal resolved_class
result_fields.predicted_class: argmax ORIGINAL logits, first class index on ties; may differ from DECLARED_FIXED explanation target
result_fields.prediction_scope: the scope actually computed by f(x)
result_fields.source_label: request source reference retained verbatim or null; independent of prediction

loss_definition.sparsity: Lm=mean(abs(M)); coarse continuous parameter weights, not binary FOV area
loss_definition.cpf: strict Ls<alpha AND Lm<beta; select maximum top1-top2 M gap, earliest feasible epoch then first flat argmax; no new positive-gap gate
loss_definition.margin: logit[resolved_class]-max(logit[other classes]); target fixed from original input for every perturbation
loss_definition.probability: stable softmax(logits)[resolved_class]; model response, not lesion probability
loss_definition.readout_fidelity: sum_c((original_logits_c-readout_logits_c)^2); descriptive float64 reconstruction from saved float32 logits, not a new CPF selection

rejection: declared_class differs from actual resolved_class under selected policy
persisted target, prediction_scope, labels, source_label or loss_definition differs from validated result
nonfinite logits, class count mismatch, unknown policy or absent required declaration
CASE/BAG source label presented as SLICE truth
3D head substituted for 2D f(x), or BAG logits substituted for SLICE logits

new_2d_predictor.input: finite float32 scalar [1,1,H,W], model-specific preprocessing bound separately; current legacy path H=W=224
new_2d_predictor.output: finite raw [1,C] SLICE logits with ordered class map; current LOC core C=2
new_2d_predictor.gradient: eval mode; parameters frozen but autograd through input/Mask enabled during optimization; no enclosing no_grad/inference_mode or detach
new_2d_predictor.bag_limit: mean-logit MIL BAG training label does not establish slice lesion/class truth; current E1/E2 may describe its versioned slice response only; bag explanation needs a separate fixed bag/aggregation/perturbation contract
new_2d_predictor.comparison: same E1 grids 16/32/64, same E2 original CPF/loss; per-model fidelity only; absolute logit loss across differently calibrated models is not classification/localization performance

legacy: P1/5F and old target0/actual1 bindings immutable; compatible raw logits reusable under explicit source/input/model/preprocessing checks; correction is a new sidecar/result version, never an overwrite
